servicios.title: Neuroaffirmative psychopedagogical support
servicios.subtitle: I support your child's learning and I support your family, from an approach that respects neurodiversity.
servicios.grid_subtitle: Four ways to support you: your child, your family, at home and in the classroom.

s1.title: Psychopedagogical support
s1.desc: Individualized intervention for children and adolescents with learning difficulties or neurodevelopmental conditions.
s1.intro: For children and adolescents with learning difficulties, autism, divergent attention (ADHD), intellectual disability, Down syndrome or educational support needs.

s2.title: Family support
s2.desc: Specialized guidance for mothers, fathers and caregivers from an empathetic, respectful perspective.
s2.intro: Specialized guidance for mothers, fathers and caregivers from an empathetic, respectful perspective focused on family support.
s2.b1: Guidance after diagnosis or the process of identifying needs
s2.b2: Understanding the condition without stigma or judgment
s2.b3: Practical strategies to apply at home
s2.b5: Support with school processes and communication with the educational institution
s2.b6: Strengthening bonds, routines and everyday ways of supporting
s2.quote: Families are not corrected; they are supported from their own history, emotions and knowledge.

s3.b4: Meaningful learning proposals for daily life

s3.b6: Guidance for mothers, fathers or caregivers to support the process at home

servicios.rule1: Sessions are scheduled in advance, based on availability.
servicios.rule2: The frequency of support can be weekly, biweekly or monthly, depending on the needs of the process.
servicios.rule3: Google Classroom is included for sending materials, tasks, guidance and follow-up.
servicios.rule4: A WhatsApp group will be set up with mothers, fathers or caregivers to facilitate communication and coordination.
servicios.rule5: Digital materials will be sent according to the established work plan.
servicios.rule6: Some physical materials may require family support to prepare at home.
servicios.rule7: When the child or adolescent already has other support professionals, coordination with the interdisciplinary team can be arranged, with the family's prior authorization, to ensure coherent, joined-up support.
servicios.rule8: The cost of consultations and sessions with the child or adolescent is set according to each family's specific needs and the characteristics of the support process.
servicios.rule9: Guidance is offered so each family can build its own family educational project, supporting organization, decision-making and ongoing support at home.
